title: Residential Electricity Supply Enrollment Eligibility Matrix
content:
Residential Electricity Supply plans are offered only to residential premises, only in the states listed for each plan, and only through the channels listed for each plan. The matrix also shows which plans a customer enrolled in a utility customer assistance program may take, and the rescission window that follows the utility's enrollment confirmation.

| Plan | Premise class | States offered | Open to assistance-program customers | Enrollment channels | Rescission window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | no | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | no | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | no | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | residential | PA, OH, IL, MD | no | phone, web | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | no | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | residential | PA, OH, NJ, MD | no | phone, web, mail | 10 |

**Reading the matrix.**

- Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 is not offered in New Jersey and cannot be enrolled by mail.
- Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 is not offered in Illinois.
- Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 is the only plan open to a customer enrolled in a utility customer assistance program.
- The rescission window is counted in calendar days after the utility's enrollment confirmation date and is 10 days on every plan.
